name: agent-worksystem-builder
description: Build and improve resumable agent work systems with persistent goals, controlled changes, independent verification and human review.

interface.longDescription: Turn a recurring task into a working local system. A coordinator composes four focused Skills for requirements, architecture and integration, controlled execution, and verification with recovery. They share one Python CLI, dependency doctor, project state and optional local MCP for the materials example. Requires Python 3.11+ and the packaged dependencies; MCP is opt-in. Live model and user-task acceptance remain pending.
defaultPrompt: Build a local workflow for processing materials with human review.
Resume my saved work system and check the next task.

publication.release_notes: Splits workflow guidance into one coordinator and four independently discoverable Skills, with shared handoff context and one runtime. Portable distribution now includes the complete Skill suite. CLI/MCP contracts are unchanged; the default plugin remains skills-only. Web import and real-model improvement remain unqualified.

zh-CN.subtitle: 构筑可恢复的智能体工作系统
zh-CN.description: 将重复任务构筑为可运行的本地系统，保存目标与决策、执行受控变更、核验任务证据、请求人工复核并恢复运行。需要 Python 3.11 及随包声明的依赖，当前为 alpha 版本。
